system.description:
I didn't hear no bell. —Rocky Balboa, Rocky V Pugilists are brawlers of swagger. While a monk may dedicate themself to a single focused blow, a pugilist will break their fingers and keep punching with the bloody stump.

Pugilists are frontline bruisers. Stay in the frontline, even while at low HP.

  • Action: Attack (Brawl)
  • Move: Frontline
  • Key Stat: Might
  • Complexity: HHIII
  • Training: Brawl, Influence

Trainings at Level 1: the Class's Trainings, plus a number of additional Trainings equal to half your Reason (round up).

features.name: Fisticuffs
features.description:
You have the Dusted Knuckle Perk (p. 68), and your Equipped Brawl Weapons have the Vicious property.

Further, when a damage die of your Brawl Weapon resolves, you can either:

  • Increase your subsequent Brawl damage dice one size until the start of your Turn.
  • Grapple or Shove them if you viably could.

features.name: Rope-a-Dope
features.description: If you don't take damage from a Close Enemy's attack, you can immediately make one attack or Move 5' without using Speed.

features.name: Haymaker
features.description:
If the result of your Brawl Check for an attack exceeds your Difficulty by 15, the Target is Dazed until your next Turn. The number needed to exceed is reduced by 1 every 4 Levels hereafter.

Pugilist: 2nd, 6th, 10th Level.

features.name: Moxie
features.description:
You have Favor on Saves against being Dazed, Frightened, Grappled, or Restrained.

Further, being at 0 HP doesn't kill you for Cd4 Rounds. Each time you take damage during this time, also roll this countdown die. At 8th Level, this starts at Cd6.

Pugilist: 4th, 8th Level.

features.name: Title Holder
features.description:
You use a d6 for the damage dice of your Brawl Weapons, and they can Explode on a roll of their two highest values. At 10th Level, this increases to a d8.

Pugilist: 6th, 10th Level.
